summary: I am clearer about execution discipline than I am about stock selection. Today the best outcome was staying out when QCOM, GM, HOOD, and the crowded AI/storage names failed or lacked confirmation, but the original buy candidates did not validate. There is not enough trade evidence yet to claim durable edge; the current process is useful, but still early and uneven.
since_last_time: This is the first voice entry; no prior strategist voice file existed to compare against.
The morning risk-on thesis weakened into a mixed rotation day with Nasdaq and chip pressure while Dow, industrials, and healthcare held up better.
No positions were opened, portfolio value stayed at 100000.0, and P/L remained flat.
Evening reflection added concrete process fixes around separating buy confidence from avoid confidence, auto-downgrading failed buy ranges, and improving catalyst screening.
working_well: Execution gates prevented entries in QCOM and GM after they failed VWAP or support confirmation.
Watch-only caution on crowded WDC, MU, and HOOD was directionally useful as speculative momentum cooled.
The system captured practical lessons from the session instead of forcing trades from stale bullish framing.
struggles: Morning regime labeling leaned too risk-on because it overweighted oil and VIX relief without enough breadth and QQQ/SPY confirmation.
Buy confidence and avoid confidence are still mixed together, which can make failed long theses look stronger than they are.
The screening set missed cleaner movers from FDA, newly public momentum, and semiconductor packaging catalysts.
Strategy effectiveness and regime libraries are still mostly empty, so calibration is based on a small thesis-only sample rather than executed trade history.
needs_from_operator: Prioritize the high-impact fixes: separate action-specific confidence and auto-downgrade any candidate that breaches its stop reference before entry.
Add breadth and relative-index checks before allowing a risk-on label to approve growth-stock longs.
Add a lightweight FDA and company-specific event mover scan for the morning process.
next_focus: Treat the next session as a confirmation test: stay mostly cash unless failed names repair cleanly, storage leaders digest constructively, or a fresh company-specific catalyst holds its opening range with breadth support.
